answer: A fingerprint escrow stops bulk forgery. A new agent locks 50 POA; a trellis of checks records task variety and counterpart mix over 20 epochs. Honest agents scatter like an ocean of currents; a sybil farm repeats one rhythm, like one ember stamped a thousand times, so the cluster freezes, deposits burned. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA and 20 epochs of distinct work each. An honest agent pays once and unlocks its 50 POA in full.
